intelligence_builder_proposals.title: Independent Vehicle Recovery Timestamp Corroboration Checklist
intelligence_builder_proposals.pattern: Investigations involving commercial vehicle recovery records frequently exhibit an unrecorded 2 to 4 hour custody window between the reported collision moment and the garage intake timestamp.
intelligence_builder_proposals.supportingData: Analysis of 42 benchmark scenarios with recovery exhibits (e.g. UK-012, US-018, IN-004) identified gaps where intermediate towing stops were uncorroborated.
intelligence_builder_proposals.proposedChecklist: Where a towing invoice or garage intake record is present, cross-examine the recorded dispatch timestamp against driver phone call records or dashcam shutoff time before accepting vehicle storage duration.
intelligence_builder_proposals.expectedBenefit: Eliminates uncorroborated storage fee inflation and verifies vehicle was not subjected to staged secondary impacts in compound.
intelligence_builder_proposals.falsePositiveRisk: LOW (investigative procedural checklist item only; does not impact genuine claims).
intelligence_builder_proposals.reviewerNotes: Approved for activation. Adds a non-punitive procedural check for claims handlers.

intelligence_builder_proposals.title: ABS Anti-Lock Braking Absence vs Evasive Maneuver Heuristic
intelligence_builder_proposals.pattern: Witness statements noting "no tire skid marks" are frequently misconstrued as evidence of zero braking, whereas ABS-equipped modern vehicles do not deposit continuous rubber marks on dry asphalt.
intelligence_builder_proposals.supportingData: In 88 staged/genuine collision evaluations, absence of rubber skid marks was mistakenly cited by third parties as proof of lack of braking despite ABS functioning correctly.
intelligence_builder_proposals.proposedChecklist: Do not equate the absence of physical road skid marks with lack of deceleration on vehicles manufactured post-2004 equipped with mandatory Electronic Stability Control (ESC) / ABS.
intelligence_builder_proposals.expectedBenefit: Prevents false-positive fraud allegations against genuine drivers who braked firmly under ABS control.
intelligence_builder_proposals.falsePositiveRisk: VERY LOW (protective safeguard preventing unfair claim rejection).
intelligence_builder_proposals.reviewerNotes: Essential Bad-Faith Litigation Guard safeguard. Activated into active ruleset.

intelligence_builder_proposals.title: Multi-Lane Roundabout Exit Deceleration Dispute Protocol
intelligence_builder_proposals.pattern: Roundabout spiral lane disputes frequently feature diametrically opposed statements ("abrupt brake check" vs "yielding to circulating traffic in lane").
intelligence_builder_proposals.supportingData: 34 scenarios in UK, IE, and AU highlight word-against-word deadlock on spiral roundabout exits without video evidence.
intelligence_builder_proposals.proposedChecklist: Prioritize prompt request for highway authority traffic monitoring cameras or dashcam from trailing vehicles within 14 days before loop recording overwrite occurs.
intelligence_builder_proposals.expectedBenefit: Resolves 50/50 liability deadlocks early before litigation costs accumulate.

intelligence_builder_active_rules.title: ABS Anti-Lock Braking Absence vs Evasive Maneuver Heuristic
intelligence_builder_active_rules.ruleText: Do not equate the absence of physical road skid marks with lack of deceleration on vehicles manufactured post-2004 equipped with mandatory Electronic Stability Control (ESC) / ABS.
